description: Wire corpus captured from DuckLakeSink and DuckLakeSource SQL patterns (v0.37.0). Contributed to RockLake project as Phase 0 validation artifact.

sql: SELECT value FROM "ducklake".ducklake_metadata WHERE key = 'version'
description: Phase 1: verify catalog is ready (replaces ensure_catalog DDL)

sql: SELECT snapshot_id, next_catalog_id, next_file_id FROM "ducklake".ducklake_snapshot ORDER BY snapshot_id DESC LIMIT 1
description: Phase 2: read last snapshot for explicit ID allocation (replaces nextval)

sql: SELECT max(snapshot_id) FROM "ducklake".ducklake_snapshot WHERE snapshot_id > $1
description: Phase 0 / source: single non-JOIN snapshot detection query

sql: SELECT schema_id FROM "ducklake".ducklake_schema WHERE schema_name = $1
description: Phase 4: schema lookup before conditional INSERT

sql: INSERT INTO "ducklake".ducklake_schema (schema_id, schema_name, begin_snapshot, end_snapshot) VALUES ($1, $2, 1, NULL)
description: Phase 4: schema insert with explicit ID (no ON CONFLICT, no RETURNING)

sql: SELECT table_id FROM "ducklake".ducklake_table WHERE schema_id = $1 AND table_name = $2
description: Phase 4: table lookup before conditional INSERT

sql: INSERT INTO "ducklake".ducklake_table (table_id, schema_id, table_name, begin_snapshot, end_snapshot) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 1, NULL)
description: Phase 4: table insert with explicit ID (no ON CONFLICT, no RETURNING)

sql: SELECT column_id FROM "ducklake".ducklake_column WHERE table_id = $1 AND column_name = $2 AND end_snapshot IS NULL
description: Phase 4: column lookup before conditional INSERT

sql: INSERT INTO "ducklake".ducklake_column (column_id, table_id, column_name, column_type, position, nulls_allowed, begin_snapshot, end_snapshot) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'VARCHAR', 0, true, $4, NULL)
description: Phase 4: additive column insert with explicit ID (no ON CONFLICT, no RETURNING)

sql: INSERT INTO "ducklake".ducklake_snapshot (snapshot_id, snapshot_time, schema_version, next_catalog_id, next_file_id) VALUES ($1, $2, 1, $3, $4)
description: Phase 2: snapshot commit with explicit IDs (no nextval, no ON CONFLICT, no RETURNING)

sql: INSERT INTO "ducklake".ducklake_data_file (data_file_id, table_id, begin_snapshot, path, record_count, file_size_bytes, footer_size) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
description: Phase 2: data file insert with explicit ID (no ON CONFLICT, no RETURNING)

sql: SELECT record_count FROM "ducklake".ducklake_table_stats WHERE table_id = $1
description: Phase 2: table stats lookup before conditional UPDATE/INSERT

sql: UPDATE "ducklake".ducklake_table_stats SET record_count = record_count + $1 WHERE table_id = $2
description: Phase 2: additive stats update (RockLake supports UPDATE)

sql: INSERT INTO "ducklake".ducklake_table_stats (table_id, record_count) VALUES ($1, $2)
description: Phase 2: table stats bootstrap (no ON CONFLICT)

sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ducklake"."ducklake_inlined_data_1_0" (row_id BIGINT NOT NULL, begin_snapshot BIGINT NOT NULL, end_snapshot BIGINT, _dedup_key TEXT NOT NULL, _subject TEXT NOT NULL, _op TEXT NOT NULL, _outbox_id BIGINT, data TEXT NOT NULL)
description: Phase 3: dynamic inlined-data DDL (CREATE TABLE ducklake_inlined_* is within RockLake bounded set)

sql: INSERT INTO "ducklake"."ducklake_inlined_data_1_0" (row_id, begin_snapshot, end_snapshot, _dedup_key, _subject, _op, _outbox_id, data) VALUES ($1, $2, NULL, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
description: Phase 3: inlined data insert without ON CONFLICT

sql: SELECT value FROM "ducklake".ducklake_metadata WHERE key = $1
description: Phase 5: metadata lookup before conditional INSERT

sql: INSERT INTO "ducklake".ducklake_metadata (key, value) VALUES ($1, $2)
description: Phase 5: partition config via ducklake_metadata (replaces tide.ducklake_partition_config)

sql: SELECT df.path, df.record_count, df.begin_snapshot FROM "ducklake".ducklake_data_file df JOIN "ducklake".ducklake_table dt ON dt.table_id = df.table_id JOIN "ducklake".ducklake_schema ds ON ds.schema_id = dt.schema_id WHERE df.begin_snapshot > $1 AND df.begin_snapshot <= $2 AND ds.schema_name = $3 AND dt.table_name = $4 AND df.end_snapshot IS NULL ORDER BY df.begin_snapshot, df.data_file_id LIMIT $5
description: Source: incremental data-file query (single allowed JOIN: data_file LEFT JOIN delete_file or JOIN table/schema for filtering)
note: This query uses multi-table JOIN which is outside RockLake Phase 4 bounded set. Will be split in v0.38.0 per rocklake.md §3.1 compatibility roadmap.

sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "ducklake"
description: DuckLakeSink.ensure_catalog() — NOT used by RockLakeSink (Phase 1 removes this)
resolution: Removed in RockLakeSink; replaced by verify_catalog_ready()

sql: SELECT nextval('"ducklake".ducklake_snapshot_id_seq')
description: DuckLakeSink ID allocation — NOT used by RockLakeSink (Phase 2 removes this)
resolution: Removed in RockLakeSink; ID allocated from next_catalog_id/next_file_id in last snapshot

sql: INSERT INTO "ducklake".ducklake_schema (...) VALUES (...) ON CONFLICT (schema_name) DO UPDATE SET ... RETURNING schema_id
description: DuckLakeSink bootstrap_table ON CONFLICT — NOT used by RockLakeSink (Phase 4 removes this)
resolution: Removed in RockLakeSink; replaced by explicit SELECT → conditional INSERT
